jobs.title: NHPC Trainee Engineer 2026: 205 Civil, Electrical & Mechanical Posts through GATE
jobs.summary: NHPC Limited (with NHDC) has notified 205 Trainee Engineer posts – Civil 64, Electrical 88 and Mechanical 53 – through GATE 2025/2026 score (Advt NH/Talent Acquisition/07/2026). Apply online by 26 December 2026.
lines: Eligibility: full-time B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc (Engg) in Civil, Electrical or Mechanical discipline with min 60% (SC/ST/PwBD 50%) + valid GATE 2025/2026 score (CE/EE/ME)
Final year: final-year appearing students are not eligible
Age: max 30 years as on 26-12-2026 (SC/ST 5, OBC-NCL 3, PwBD 10 years relaxation)
Pay: Rs 50,000-3%-1,60,000 (IDA), E2; annual emoluments approx Rs 16-17 lakh
Fee: Rs 708 for UR/EWS/OBC-NCL; nil for SC/ST/PwBD/Women/Ex-SM
Selection: GATE marks 75% + Group Discussion 5% + Interview 20%
Dates: apply 27 Nov (10 AM) – 26 Dec 2026 (5 PM)

jobs.title: WBSETCL Recruitment 2026: 202 JE, Special Technical Assistant, Office Executive & Other Posts
jobs.summary: West Bengal State Electricity Transmission Company Limited has notified 202 posts – Junior Engineer (Elect.) Gr-II 100, Special Technical Assistant 40, Linesman 40, Office Executive 20 and Junior Surveyor 2 (REC/2026/04). Apply online by 15 December 2026.
lines: Eligibility: JE – 3-yr Diploma in Electrical Engg; STA – Diploma in Electronics & Tele-Communication; Junior Surveyor – Diploma in Survey Engg; Office Executive – Graduate (50%) + computer course or BBA/BCA etc.; Linesman – Madhyamik + ITI; West Bengal domicile and Bengali/Nepali required
Final year: final-semester students can sit the CBT; result needed by interview date
Age: 18–37 years as on 01-01-2026 (SC/ST 5, OBC 3 years relaxation; PwBD up to 45)
Pay: Level-6 Rs 36,800–1,06,700 (JE/STA/Surveyor); Level-4 Rs 29,000–84,500 (Office Executive); Level-3 Rs 23,400–68,900 (Linesman)
Fee: Nil
Selection: CBT (85 marks, 90 min, −0.33 negative) + Interview (15 marks) + medical
Dates: apply 25 Nov – 15 Dec 2026 (11:55 PM)
